entities.name: Alfonso Martínez de Toledo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alfonso Martínez de Toledo, known as the Archpriest of Talavera, was a Castilian poet and writer. He was born and studied in Toledo, Spain, spent time in Catalonia and Aragón, and served as a prebendary at the cathedral of Toledo. He then became archpriest at Talavera.
